notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Patron of the Orochi and Volrath has at least one counter.
You control Forests and/or green creatures that can tap to produce at least {G}{G}.
description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi until your next turn.
Put Patron of the Orochi into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate all Forests and mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of itself as Patron of the Orochi until your next turn.
Repeat from step 3.
